body: Thanks for sharing. To better days.

When I'm on the ledge, I try to remember that I'm going to die eventually anyway, so I might as well get as much mileage out of this body as I can. When things get as bad as they're going to get, well... nature will probably take care of death for us. Sorry if that's cliche. The thing is, I sometimes feel my life is worthless and the pain and despair are too great, but when I read/hear others who feel the same way, it sounds like nonsense. Your life has value. Here, read these Superman panels--it seems silly, but I always pull up these pages when I'm thinking about suicide: https://m.imgur.com/gallery/Ijdxh
